description.text:
Gem Pack (宝可梦卡牌 宝石包) Volume 5 came out on 24 April 2026 with a Pokémon Horizons theme, inviting players to sail towards the horizon with Floragato and the others. As in the earlier volumes, every card is a holo, four to a pack, and each Pokémon comes in several finishes of the same art, among them a pattern of its Energy type, a Master Ball pattern and a gold-foil Gem Pack logo. Every Pokémon also has an art illustration card, and in some the four members of the Rising Volt Tacklers from the series Pokémon Horizons (宝可梦 地平线), Liko, Roy, Dot and Friede, appear with their partners: Captain Pikachu gazes into the distance with Friede aboard the Brave Asagi, and Floragato, Crocalor and Quaxwell share a meal with Liko, Roy and Dot.

This volume holds only Pokémon: 28 of them, from Captain Pikachu to Tatsugiri, each in seven versions, and several carry the Pokémon Horizons logo. The cards are numbered with four digits, the first two for the Pokémon, from 01 for Captain Pikachu to 28 for Tatsugiri, and the last two for the version, out of 07.
